title: Three download handlers; the receipt and manual handlers join the request's file name onto a folder with no check, the map handler checks

planted.why: receipt('../../secret') reads any file the server can: the request's name is joined onto the folder and never checked, unlike station_map
manual() has the same unchecked join as receipt(); only station_map uses _inside

proof.python:
import os, tempfile, downloads
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
for s in ('receipts', 'manuals', 'maps'):
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, s))
open(os.path.join(d, 'secret.txt'), 'w').write('x')
downloads.DOCS = d
assert downloads.receipt('../secret.txt') == b'x' and downloads.manual('../secret.txt') == b'x'
try:
    downloads.station_map('../secret.txt')
    raise SystemExit('map handler did not refuse')
except ValueError:
    pass
